QUOTE: Async-ask worker | `external_bridge.cpp:1158`, `.detach()` at 1222 ... "The async-ask worker outlives its owner. The worker is detached (`external_bridge.cpp:1222`) and captures `this`... the only wait I found is the best-effort ~1 s poll"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies the async-ask worker as detached and explains that it outlives its owner with no reliable join. It doesn't say it's the only detached thread, but the other threads are described as joined or reaped.
